headline: Frozen competition is tightening around restaurant brands, protein claims and AI-led grocery discovery; Real Dough has no current paid/social analytics feed wired into this repo.

items: Market intel feed is current through 2026-07-31 with five daily reports for ISO week 31.
Ingredient scrutiny is moving toward Real Dough territory: Florida subpoenaed General Mills over potassium bromate while California and New York pressure additive use in breadmaking.
Hospitality reputation signal remains healthy across the Merriment Social group: listed Google ratings are 4.4 Merriment, 4.5 Third Coast, 4.5 Flourchild and 4.7 Loon Room.
Premium frozen is getting more crowded: CPK/Nestle is expanding CPK consumer packaged goods into U.S. frozen appetizers and entrees for early 2027.
Large brands are pushing protein-led frozen meals: Campbell's Chunky is entering frozen bowls with eight SKUs and up to 28g protein.
Grocery product discovery is shifting upstream: Kroger and Schnucks both advanced AI shopping assistants for meal planning, nutrition goals and basket-building.
Midwest value pressure is active: C&S cut prices 6% to 15% on thousands of items across banners including Wisconsin Piggly Wiggly.
Ask agency to reinforce original Wisconsin sourdough / clean dough transparency; this is defensible against additive scrutiny and private-label clarity moves.
Pressure-test PDP, Instacart/retailer copy and search terms for AI grocery assistants: sourdough, clean ingredients, Wisconsin, premium frozen pizza and quick meal occasions.
Do not rely on stale Whatagraph. Wire the current paid/social/content analytics source into the repo before making performance claims.
Monitor pricing response in Midwest accounts where C&S/Piggly Wiggly value resets may make premium frozen trade-up messaging harder.

agency_brief.what_worked: The strongest available story this week is positioning, not performance: clean sourdough process, Wisconsin origin and premium frozen convenience line up with current market pressure around additives, private-label clarity and AI-driven meal planning.
agency_brief.what_didnt: No current paid, organic social or content-performance feed is wired into this repo, so there is no defensible basis here to name winning creative, channels or spend efficiency for the week.
agency_brief.recommendation: Build next week's messaging around “original Wisconsin sourdough” and clean dough transparency; make retailer/marketplace copy explicit enough for AI shopping assistants and search-driven grocery baskets.
agency_brief.competitive_context: CPK/Nestle and Campbell's are expanding branded frozen meals, Mason Dixie is using Costco for clean-label frozen convenience, and grocers are testing AI assistants that can redirect meal planning before shoppers reach the freezer door.

missing: Current paid/social/content analytics source is not wired into this repo; no weekly campaign-performance claims were made.
No current Real Dough operations feed is available from the approved sources for this run; decommissioned data/operations was intentionally not used.
